<function name="SetConVarY" parent="DSlider" type="panelfunc">
	<description>Sets the <page>ConVar</page> to be set when the slider changes on the Y axis.
	</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="convar" type="string">Name of the convar to set.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
